patterns.description: 97% of cuts land on the beat (within 70 ms), so the edit is cut to the music.
In the build, the edit cuts every 8 beats (3.93 s at 122 BPM); 2 of 2 shots follow it.
In the drop, the edit cuts every beat (0.49 s at 122 BPM); 23 of 34 shots follow it.
Cutting speeds up when the drop hits: 0.12 -> 2.59 cuts per second (20.9x faster).
A flash transition lands right on the drop (8.12 s).
A rotate effect lands right on the drop (8.12 s).
A zoom effect lands right on the drop (8.12 s).
Blur effects hit on the beat (9 of 10).
Zoom effects hit on the beat (12 of 15).
Speed ramps start or land on a beat (7 of 8).
The edit cuts away and comes back to the same clip 7 times (source groups G, N, R, U, V).
